 How to watch Kairat v Panathinaikos: Live stream, TV channel and kick-off time
 Ellis Statham
 Published: 7 hours ago
 Kairat and Panathinaikos lock horns in Matcheweek 2 of the 2026/27 Conference League on Thursday afternoon. 
 Thursday's hosts were held to a 1-1 draw in their Conference League opener against Riga last Thursday, while Greek outfit Panathinaikos got off to a winning start, overcoming Borac in narrow 2-1 fashion thanks to goals from Cyriel Dessers and Kings Kangwa.

 How to watch Kairat v Panathinaikos, live stream and TV channel
 Kairat v Panathinaikos is being broadcast live in the UK on TNT Sports 9.
 Live streaming is also available via HBO Max.
 Kairat v Panathinaikos kick-off time, date and venue
 Kairat v Panathinaikos will be played at the Almaty Central Stadium in Kazakhstan on Thursday 22nd October and kick-off is scheduled for 15:30 BST.
